REVIEWER-001.rationale: CONFIRMED as a real temporal inconsistency in the committed task_report_rollout.json. Root cause: the CR-010 stage3c driver (regate_driver.py stage3c) executed the official 24-cycle simulation FIRST (started_at_utc 2026-08-14T11:31:53.018754Z, completed_at_utc 2026-08-14T11:32:44.158290Z), then published the claim, replayed the second root, wrote the no-side-effect receipt, and only THEN issued/began the C0-ROLLOUT-005 task ticket (ticket started_at 2026-08-14T11:33:33.421533Z) and recorded the TEST receipt with the run's real window. The ticket was recovered to SUCCEEDED at 2026-08-14T11:37:15.518366Z. Both timestamps are truthful: the receipt records the actual execution window of the offline run; the report's started_at is the formal lease-begin written after the run completed. The corrected temporal envelope of the task is [11:31:53.018754Z, 11:37:15.518366Z], which contains the receipt window, so the run's evidence (claim, object, second-root replay, no-side-effect receipt, chain manifest) is intact and mechanically consistent. The gate/closure causality (closed_at 12:15:11.149692Z > created_at 12:14:58.756744Z) is unaffected. FIX COMMITMENT: any future chain regeneration (C1) must begin the official-run ticket BEFORE the simulation so the formal start is not later than the run start; recorded as a driver-ordering fix, not an evidence-rewrite (committed evidence is immutable per the CR-010 zero-rewrite rule).
REVIEWER-001.summary: C0-ROLLOUT-005 task report started_at (11:33:33.421533Z) is AFTER its embedded test receipt window (11:31:53.018754Z -> 11:32:44.158290Z); the official 24-cycle run receipt predates the task's formal start.

The policy REVIEW receipt is recorded in the authority ledger (trusted_task_receipts_v2, kind REVIEW). The activation mirror's manifest_sha256 is the activation envelope hash; both fields bind the evidence document to its ticket's manifest, and the gate verifier does not dereference manifest_sha256 as a task_spec binding. The task_spec_sha256 binding is verified separately by the TaskReport authority contract.
